text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen. Meisho Doto,
who had 
always chased T.M. Opera O from behind, 
stands alongside her for the first time
as a top favorite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Six months ago,
when Admire Vega withdrew, 
T.M. Opera O said that all they could do 
was wait. That was because...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It signaled Meisho Doto's awakening. 
Now—she had to show them her running form 
at the peak of its true potential.
